csv_project_name: Design for Mohican State Park Pool Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR), through the Division of Parks and Watercraft is responsible for the management of all facilities at Mohican State Park. The Park campground currently includes a swimming pool and support buildings which have exceeded their useful life. At this stage, both the pool, its infrastructure, and operating systems are experiencing failures, and it has been determined they are in need of restoration and/or replacement. This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is being issued to obtain Professional Design & Construction Administration (A/E) services for renovation/replacement work The selected team will develop site-specific plans and reconcile any existing studies for selected locations, beginning with the confirmation of facility and site assessments. These reconciliations will address the site utilization needs of various user groups, and utility infrastructure needs versus constraints. They will also include recommended scopes of construction projects and appropriate phasing.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Materials Testing, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics

title: Design for Mohican State Park Pool Improvements
short_description: Design services for renovation or replacement of a state park swimming pool complex.
project_scope: Renovation and/or replacement of the existing swimming pool, support buildings, pool infrastructure, and operating systems at Mohican State Park campground. The selected team is to confirm facility and site assessments, reconcile existing studies, evaluate site utilization for different user groups, assess utility infrastructure needs and constraints, and recommend construction scopes and phasing. Total construction cost is stated as 3.5 million.
services: Professional design and construction administration (A/E) services, including architecture, landscape architecture, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, materials testing, hazardous waste engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and hydrology/hydraulics.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a pool and support building renovation/replacement project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, tower, or special structure.
- Includes structural engineering within a multidisciplinary A/E scope, but structural complexity appears limited.
- Project is a refurbishment/replacement of existing recreational facilities rather than an architecturally demanding or innovative structure.
- Moderate strategic relevance only because it includes design services and construction administration.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source.
references_qualifications: RFQ for professional A/E services; specific reference or qualification requirements are not stated in the provided source excerpt. Requested disciplines include architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, hydrology/hydraulics, landscape architecture, surveying/GIS/mapping, hazardous waste engineering, materials testing, and construction/project management.
